scope: One exposed development trajectory; fixed-policy consumer-wait attribution and instrumentation guard

execution_budget.start: On explicit execution, before substantive work; never directory timestamp

instrumentation.clock_calibration: Freeze bounded count at request boundaries in both arms; propagate mapping uncertainty
instrumentation.missing_edges: Unknown, conservative bounds; never zero by default

instrumentation_gate.failed_gate: Retain all observations and structural traces; downgrade quantitative attribution. No repetitions to neutralize timing.

decision_rules.consistency: All three TRACE runs; fidelity, coverage and symmetric perturbation gates must pass

baseline.definition: Recorded readiness and measured work unchanged

primary.fixed_rule: For each publication, remove only max(0, host_ack_wait_end - worker_notify_unlock_return - measured_host_wait_thread_cpu). Keep worker command/wakeup, metadata submit/completion, ack state/notification/unlock, all measured host wait CPU, ownership commit and downstream required work/dependency durations unchanged. If notification return occurs after host resume, removal is zero.
primary.clock_domain: All defining timestamps use the same host monotonic domain; device mapping is used only for dependent-path propagation.
primary.unobserved_required_constraint: Preserve or widen bounds, including zero contribution; never assume an absent dependency has zero duration.

idealized.fixed_rule: Move acknowledgment readiness to publication command availability after completed weights and actual publication validation; idealize metadata/notification service to zero while retaining external model work and ownership/read-safety ordering.
idealized.meaning: Deliberately optimistic opportunity upper bound, separate from primary scenario uncertainty

uncertainty.definition: For each fixed scenario c separately, S_c=(T_recorded-T_counterfactual_c)/T_recorded. [S_c_min,S_c_max] varies timing/edge evidence consistent with clock brackets, unsupported paths, missing dependencies and graph residuals; it does not vary intervention strength and does not automatically include the baseline.
uncertainty.point_estimate: Optional explicitly labeled representative reconstruction; decisions use propagated bounds only.
